scandals.name: Adani Group Airport Lease
scandals.summary: Secretive 30-year lease agreement to give Adani Group control of JKIA in exchange for refurbishment; suspended by High Court conservatory orders following public interest litigation.

scandals.name: KETRACO Power Transmission PPP Deal
scandals.summary: Privately Initiated Proposal (PIP) concession awarded to Adani Energy Solutions to construct 422km of high-voltage transmission lines; halted by High Court pending constitutional challenge.
